summary: Five dependency-free subpackages under base/: rope (ropey 2 API subset Base uses: byte-indexed, LF lines, char/UTF-16/line conversions, persistent O(1) copies, iterators), sumtree (zed-sum-tree SumTree + Cursor[D] with Bias/Dimensions), segment (word/grapheme over github.com/clipperhouse/uax29/v2 v2.7.0 + Base's text_boundary.rs), dataurl (data-url crate port incl. MIME parsing and forgiving base64), strftime (chrono strftime normal + lenient modes over zone-less time.Time). go.mod gains its first requirement (uax29, approved in ticket 01).
